logo_override.alt_text: 留学中国 Study in China
logo_override.validation_detail: webfetch returned 'Image fetched successfully', confirming HTTP 200 plus a real image content type rather than the WAF interstitial. Decoded and rendered: the full-colour Study in China lockup - circular globe emblem at left with the blue Chinese calligraphy 留学中国 and the words STUDY IN CHINA beneath. Pixel analysis: 190x55, 0.0% transparent (jpg, no alpha channel), mean luminance 222.8 with 71.8% near-white pixels forming the background field and 0.0% dark pixels - the artwork itself is mid-tone brand blue. Because the background is opaque white rather than transparent, the blue mark is fully legible on a light card and there is no white-on-transparent variant.

notes: campuschina.org is behind a bot-protection layer that webfetch cannot pass: every webfetch of the site returned 'Transport error', and a direct .NET request returned HTTP 412 Precondition Failed (DNS resolves to 203.33.8.147 and TCP 443 connects, so the host is live - 412 is the WAF, not a dead site). Per brief section 2.4 I opened it with Playwright instead, which rendered the page (title 'Home_留学中国') and exposed the markup. The header brand is a CSS background rather than an , so a plain markup scan finds nothing; I enumerated every computed background-image on the page and pixel-analysed the plausible candidates via canvas. Rejected: /images/headerinc.png (30x30, 100% pure-white opaque pixels - a blank UI glyph, not a mark), /images/images/icon_11.png (95x96, mixed-tone UI icon), and the many /images/icon_*.png, /images/t1.png, /images/t2.png, /images/m1.png, /images/home_15.jpg decoration assets. Selected the 190x55 /Upload/image/... jpg because its aspect ratio and content identify it as the actual 留学中国 / Study in China programme lockup, which is the correct awarding-body mark for this record: the Chinese Government Scholarship is a Chinese state programme administered through the Ministry of Education's Study in China / CSC framework, and this is that framework's own mark on the portal's own domain, so rule 1 and rule 2 both hold. image_kind is official_government rather than official_logo because the awarding body here is a state programme, not a commercial or university body. Noted for the data side: the shard record leaves official_source null, but campuschina.org is the Ministry of Education portal for this scheme, so the awarding body should be credited as the Chinese Government / CSC (Ministry of Education) rather than left blank.
